ns2:course.label: Qualitative Analysis of Video Data
ns2:course.description: Attends to the special affordances of video data and the key decision points and criteria to justify claims from video. Discussions will emphasize the relevant theoretical, methodological, and ethical considerations for each of those decision points. Students will analyze a selection of video data of their choosing to build and support a claim and justify their methodological choices. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: A basic qualitative methods course (CI 509, CI 519, EPOL 585, EPS 515, EPSY 577, or EPSY 578), or equivalent graduate-level introductory qualitative methods course, or permission of instructor.
